title: Undercurrents Surging
next_chapter_hook: However, when Chen Ji examined the handwriting on the impeachment memorial, his pupils constricted sharply—that familiar brush style, those distinctive turns—clearly the work of a Ling family幕僚. Ling Yuan, you finally couldn't hold back.

text.content:
Imperial Capital, Daming Palace.

The dragon's saliva incense rose in wisps atop the Golden Phoenix Hall, yet it could not suppress the killing intent permeating today's court. The Crown Prince stood at the edge of the crimson steps, his expression as usual, only those deep eyes flickering with a barely perceptible cold gleam.

"I impeach the Crown Prince for employing a sorcerer, causing the Tianji Pavilion ruins to spiral out of control, damaging the dragon veins, and bringing calamity upon the people!" The Censorate's Censor Wang's voice echoed through the hall, ringing with authority. The gaze of all officials fell like knives upon the usually gentle heir.

The Crown Prince's fingers tightened imperceptibly within his sleeve, yet his face remained that of serene detachment. He knew—the true storm had only just begun.

dialogue.content: (Far away in a teahouse thousands of miles distant, Chen Ji set down his teacup, a meaningful smile curving his lips.) Censor Wang… merely a chess piece. The true chess player is still waiting for this play to reach its climax.

text.content:
Meanwhile, in a secret underground palace somewhere in the Celestial Dome Domain, three imposing figures sat around an ancient stone table.

"Did Chen Ji really die?" The speaker was Zhou Tong, senior disciple under the Xuanwu Sect Master's seat, his fleshy face betraying a hint of wariness. "During the last rift dispute, he alone stirred up the situation and even caused Senior Brother Han to suffer a hidden loss."

On the other side, the beautiful female cultivator of the White Tiger Sect covered her lips and smiled lightly: "The dead don't speak, the living do. Have any of you considered—if that废物 truly died, why would the Crown Prince be so eager to distance himself?"

"Threat level upgraded to S-class." The third faction's representative, who had remained silent, finally spoke, their voice like ice cracking. "A living Chen Ji is more dangerous than a dead one—at least the dead don't lay schemes."

dialogue.content:
(Chen Ji's fingertips lightly touched the hidden communication talisman in his sleeve, a message only he could hear resonating in his Mental Sea.) "The new terms have been drafted. The agreement between us should be upgraded. Three days later, at the old Qingyun Peak site. Be there or not." That cold yet alluring female voice belonged exclusively to Ye Qing.

Chen Ji's gaze shifted slightly. The Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea grew faintly warm, as if reminding him—the gears of fate had turned another notch.

choice.prompt: Faced with the undercurrents of three factions and Ye Qing's new invitation, Chen Ji must make a choice—continue to lie in wait and observe, or take the initiative to stir up the storm?

choices.description: Continue feigning death, secretly gather intelligence from all sides, and wait for the optimal moment to strike. Advance steadily and surely, leaving enemies no opening.
choices.risk_hint: Various Factions May Accelerate Their Plans

text.content:
Chen Ji returned the communication talisman to his sleeve, closed his eyes, and concentrated. The Tianji Record Fragment slowly unfurled in his Mental Sea, countless images flickering like a carousel—the invisible hand standing behind Censor Wang was quietly reaching toward the Crown Prince. And he simply needed to wait quietly.

"Good," he murmured, "let them fight a while longer."

choices.text: Take the Initiative, Stir the Waters
choices.description: Use the intelligence at hand to ignite a powder keg between the Crown Prince and the impeachment forces, letting enemies destroy each other. Proactively create chaos, seeking opportunity within crisis.

text.content:
"Since there must be chaos," Chen Ji opened his eyes, cold light flashing in his gaze, "let it be thorough."

He drew from his sleeve an ancient jade slip—a communication jade slip long since失效—yet to him, its true value lay in the line of text upon it.

This was the "token of allegiance" he had deliberately left for the Crown Prince three years ago. Now, it was time to put it to use.

choices.description: Travel to Qingyun Peak to meet Ye Qing, learn about the new developments of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path and her key intelligence. First consolidate this important alliance.

text.content:
"Ye Qing…" Chen Ji murmured, "The movements of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path may be more critical than the struggles at court."

He rose and pushed open the window, gazing at the twilight-shrouded horizon in the distance. The Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea trembled faintly, as if reminding him—cooperation with Ye Qing had always been a double-edged sword.

But at present, this sword he must grasp.

Meanwhile, in a secluded mansion somewhere in the Imperial Capital.

A white-haired elder sat in his study, before him lay a密函 freshly delivered. His withered fingers drummed lightly on the desk, each tap seeming to strike the nodes of destiny.

"Feigning death…" Ling Yuan's clouded eyes flickered with keen light, "This boy, he actually learned to hide his talents. But playing such tricks before me? Far too naive."

He lifted his brush and inscribed several lines on a blank memorial. Each stroke was forceful yet concealed deadly intent.

"Since you wish to die, I shall oblige—letting you die once, for real."

dialogue.content: (Ling Yuan sealed the memorial and handed it to the black-clad figure beside him.) "This memorial must reach the Imperial presence within three days. Remember—let the Crown Prince's people see it first."

text.content:
Three days later, the old Qingyun Peak site.

Among the ruins of crumbling walls, withered grass rustled in the wind. This had once been a sacred site of the cultivation world, now reduced to a chessboard for various factions.

A graceful figure stood upon the ruins, black纱 veiling her face, demonic energy faintly emanating. She was the Holy Sect Saint—Ye Qing.

"You came." Her voice was cold with a hint of complexity. "More punctual than I expected."

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji strode from the shadows, his white robes pristine as snow, his expression tranquil.) "New terms—I'm curious what price the Saint can offer?"

text.content:
Ye Qing removed her veil, revealing a coldly beautiful visage. Deep within her eyes lay secrets even Chen Ji could not fully penetrate.

"First, I want you to help me eliminate the traitors within the Holy Sect—they use my clanspeople as sacrifices in exchange for cultivation advancement." Her voice held no波 yet her fingertips trembled slightly, betraying her inner fury.

"Second, I've obtained news…" She paused, her gaze piercing Chen Ji like a blade. "Regarding your sister's whereabouts."

dialogue.content:
(Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, his fingers within his sleeve clenching into fists.) What did you say?

(Ye Qing sensed the fluctuation in his aura and a meaningful smile curved her lips.) "It seems your weakness is indeed that girl."

choice.prompt: Ye Qing dropped a bombshell—she knew Chen Nian's whereabouts. Facing this lead about his missing sister, Chen Ji must choose:

choices.description: Stay calm, reveal no flaws to Ye Qing. Extract more intelligence about Chen Nian from her, seizing the initiative.
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing May Use This to Threaten

text.content:
Chen Ji drew a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the churning emotions. His eyes regained clarity, and even a smile appeared at the corners of his mouth.

"Interesting." He approached Ye Qing slowly, his voice low. "Is the Saint threatening me, or proposing a transaction?"

choices.text: Direct Pressure, Force Her to Surrender Intelligence
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record's foresight ability to display partial trumps, letting Ye Qing know she cannot push him around. Use a forceful stance to compel her to hand over intelligence about Chen Nian.

text.content:
Chen Ji offered no answer, merely raising his hand. The Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve blazed with sudden light as an arcane rune coalesced at his fingertip, transforming into a blurry image—the very location hidden in Ye Qing's memories.

"This page," Chen Ji's voice was placid, "is it sufficient as a token of sincerity?"

choices.description: Outwardly accept Ye Qing's terms, secretly lay plans. Propose your own附加 conditions, transforming this transaction into a true exchange of interests.
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing May Turn the Tables

text.content:
"Very well." Chen Ji nodded, his expression returning to normal. "I accept both conditions. But I have附加 conditions—everything you know about my sister, from this moment forward, must be shared with me."

He stepped forward, locking eyes with Ye Qing: "This is cooperation, not charity."

dialogue.content:
(Ye Qing slightly raised an eyebrow, clearly not expecting such straightforwardness.) "Aren't you afraid I buried traps within the terms?"

(Chen Ji gave a light laugh.) "If the Saint wished to harm me, you wouldn't have cooperated with me that day. In the end, we are both可怜 people swept along by fate—except I'm better at surviving in the cracks."

text.content:
The moment the two reached preliminary agreement, the communication jade symbol in Chen Ji's sleeve suddenly grew warm. He frowned, probing with his divine sense—

It was an intelligence report from his eyes and ears in the Imperial Capital.

"The Crown Prince's Tutor Disappearance Case takes a major turn! Someone has filed a实名 accusation implicating the Crown Prince in the Tianji Pavilion ruins! The impeachment memorial has reached His Majesty, who is furious! What's more strange—the handwriting on that memorial is suspected to be from the Ling family!"

dialogue.content:
(After reading the report, the smile on Chen Ji's face gradually froze, replaced by a deep chill.) Ling Yuan… finally couldn't hold back.

(Ye Qing noticed his unusual reaction and frowned.) "What's wrong?"

(Chen Ji put away the jade symbol, cold light flickering in his eyes.) "Nothing. Just an old fox has emerged from its lair ahead of schedule."

text.content:
Imperial Capital, outside the Imperial Study.

The Crown Prince knelt on the cold golden bricks, behind him stood a host of terrified officials. The Emperor on the dragon throne was ashen, the memorial in his hand crushed out of shape.

"Crown Prince! You explain to朕—this memorial states that Chen Ji in the Tianji Pavilion ruins never actually died, but was a feigned death orchestrated by you?!"

The Crown Prince bowed his head, his voice calm yet tinged with defiance: "Your son… has nothing to say."

dialogue.content:
(Watching from the shadows, Ling Yuan stroked his beard with a satisfied smile. In his view, Chen Ji was already a弃子, and the Crown Prince was about to be pulled down as well.) The大局… is settled.

(Yet he did not know that within that seemingly ordinary communication jade slip, Chen Ji had long since planted a contingency—the "token of allegiance" left three years ago was precisely the key to breaking the game at this moment.)

text.content:
Thousands of miles away, Chen Ji stood atop the Qingyun Peak ruins, gazing toward the Imperial Capital.

"Ling Yuan…" his voice was soft, yet seemed to pierce through space, "You think capturing the Crown Prince will bring me down? Too naive."

The Tianji Record Fragment slowly unfurled in his Mental Sea, countless threads of cause and effect weaving into a net. And at the deepest point of that great net, a name赫然 connected—

Chen Nian.

"Little sister… wait for me." Chen Ji clenched his fists. "This time, I shall be the chess player."

However, when Chen Ji examined the intelligence report from the Imperial Capital, his pupils contracted sharply—that handwriting on the impeachment memorial, those distinctive turns and pauses, he knew it too well.

Three years ago, he had picked up a discarded note outside the Ling family residence. The handwriting on it was identical to today's memorial.

"Ling Yuan…" Chen Ji's voice turned ice-cold, "You've finally made your move. Since you want to play, I'll play along to the end."

He turned to Ye Qing, determination flashing in his gaze: "The new terms are void. Saint, I have a new proposal—let us join forces and overturn the Ling family. How about it?"

Ye Qing stared in momentary shock, then burst into laughter. That laughter was clear and unrestrained, carrying a sense of release after being toyed with by fate.

"Chen Ji ah Chen Ji," she wiped the tear from her eye, "you truly have not disappointed me. Fine—I agree."

The two clapped hands as their oath. Demonic Path and Heavenly Secrets, at this moment, intertwined into a new alliance.

And within the undercurrents of the Imperial Capital, yet another new force quietly joined the battlefield. The Crown Prince's fate, Ling Yuan's conspiracy, Chen Nian's whereabouts—all threads converged at this moment into a raging storm.

The tempest, at last, was about to arrive.
